free_tier.stated: No free sandbox allowance is published. Registering a template costs nothing until a sandbox is launched, and compute bills per second while it runs.
free_tier.notes: The live hourly rate is shown only in the console launch estimate; the docs pricing page declines to mirror rates. No free compute credit for Agentbox is published.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a sandbox, not an object
per_object_cap.notes: Uploads are limited to about 500 MB each; this is a transfer limit, not a storage cap.

retention.stated: A paused sandbox is kept for up to 7 days, then deleted with its disk; a sandbox uses a 24-hour default lifetime that renews automatically.

egress.terms: Shared data center outbound IP address; some sites block cloud IPs, and GMI offers an allowlist or a dedicated egress IP. No included volume or data-out price is published.

interface_detail: Python and Go Agentbox SDKs plus a REST control plane and per-sandbox data plane: launch, pause, resume, execute commands, transfer files, open a PTY and keep durable snapshots.
tooling: The user installs the Python or Go SDK and calls the hosted GMI API; the vendor runs the sandboxes.
chaining: Agents registered on GMI can use GMI model inference through one key and bill together, or connect a self-hosted agent that uses GMI only for tokens.

limits.value: paused sandboxes kept for up to 7 days; default sandbox lifetime 24 hours, minimum 60 seconds
one shell connection at a time per sandbox
429 on too many requests; exact rate not published

limits_note: Without balance or credit a sandbox can launch and then stop a few seconds after launch. A sandbox must listen on the internal port to serve external traffic.
binding_note: The account needs a positive balance or credit before a sandbox survives launch, and the live compute rate is only disclosed in the console.

identity_cost.detail: The console sign-up offers email and password or Google, GitHub and Hugging Face; email verification completes registration. Payment details for topping up the balance were not seen.

reliability_note: A sandbox without balance stops within seconds of launch; the shared data center egress IP is blocked by some sites; Docker is not available inside a sandbox.
confidence_note: The hosted offer, per-second billing, limits and sign-in fields are quoted from first-party docs read on 2026-11-25; the live rate is console-only and the planning rate comes from a vendor blog.
